title: 李光耀毒虾论：苏纳克却拿来谈经济，中等强国真能靠不可或缺立足？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think the other way, though, is to remember a little bit what Lee Kuan Yew said about Singapore, when he talked about the big fish eating the small fish and the small fish eating the shrimps.
segments.zh: 不过，我认为另一种方式是回想一下李光耀关于新加坡的言论，他谈到大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米。

segments.en: And he was thinking about what will Singapore's path going to be in that world and it was well, we have to make ourselves a poisonous shrimp. And what does that mean in today's world economically,
segments.zh: 他当时在思考新加坡在那个世界中的道路会是什么，结论是，我们必须把自己变成一只毒虾。这在当今经济世界中意味着什么，

segments.en: whilst these middle powers, they can't be independent, they can't operate at the scale of the big ones. What they can do is make themselves indispensable.
segments.zh: 而这些中等强国，它们无法独立，也无法以大国规模运作。它们能做的是让自己变得不可或缺。
